frontMatter.title: Thursday Club Night — Last One of January!
frontMatter.summary: Join us at Claremont for the final Thursday Club Night of January: Navan ‘A’ vs Ardee (Grade 2 Mixed), Navan ‘B’ vs Skryne ‘A’ (Grade 4 Mixed), plus 2 member courts available from 9:30pm.

prev.title: Wednesday Club Night: Navan 'A' vs Trim 'A' + Members’ Courts from 8pm
prev.summary: Cup action this Wednesday as Navan 'A' take on Trim 'A' in the Grade 5 Men’s cup match. Two courts available for members from 8pm, with juveniles playing league matches only.

next.title: Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims – Best of Luck to Our Meath Representatives
next.summary: The Leinster CAC Intercounty Prelims take place this Sunday, 1st February, across Meath, Dublin, Carlow, and Wicklow. Best of luck to our club members representing Meath across Grades 2 and 4.
